engine: Strength is the class ability. Momentum starts/ends encounters at0; cap5, rising to7 with Momentum Overflow or automatically at class9. On each regular turn, moving at least15ft under your own power grants1 Momentum, and damaging an enemy with a weapon attack grants1 more. These are the only default gains; all gains/refunds together cap2 per round. Forced movement, teleportation, movement in place, allies and summons cannot farm Momentum. Movement counts actual path traveled toward a tactical destination; one threshold per turn.

A leap technique moves you through an unobstructed arc to a visible unoccupied landing space within its range, adjacent to its target when attacking. Land during the same activation. It spends movement equal to horizontal distance, unless the card expressly supplies additional movement. A leap never gives flight, indefinite airborne immunity or free attacks. You cannot leap through ceilings/walls; vertical height is at most half the printed horizontal range. Safe technique landings do not cause self-fall damage; interrupted/falling travel follows ordinary falling rules. No bonus damage is earned by repeatedly dropping from a ledge.

All attack cards use a wielded polearm unless they explicitly describe a non-weapon save effect. A technique is its own Action, not an Attack Action plus free technique. At class5 your ordinary Attack Action makes two attacks, at most two even when multiclass features overlap; each technique still gives only printed attacks. This automatic Extra Attack is a new explicit advancement specification for the pilot.

Armor bypass means the exact printed attack bonus or resistance exception, never subtracting a percentage of the target's whole AC. Critical ranges do not stack. A Dragoon can use only one free/Bonus Action leap granted by class features per round; it cannot trigger another free leap. Extra full Actions share the suite-wide cap. Reaction intercepts require a legal path and destination and do not rewind resolved damage.

Spending Momentum pays before resolution; a hit refund cannot pay its own activation. Burn means1d4 fire at start of target's next2 turns, nonstacking. Bleed means1d4 physical at start of next2 turns; an Action with a healer's kit ends it. DoTs give no Momentum or critical triggers. Hard denial uses the shared once-per-target/encounter guard.

When casting an ordinary spell after moving at least20ft this turn, reduce that cast's Dissonance gain by1, minimum0; no automatic RP discount. Dragoon techniques are martial unless their card specifies elemental magic. Use CoreV2 RP and the Dragoon rank gates for separate spellcasting.

Use scheduled Base/Arch/Hero choices. Skybound Assault, Momentum Engine and related passives improve the automatic engine rather than unlock basic movement or generation. Lancer's Apex is automatic9; at10 choose Dragon Guardian, Drake Rider or Dragon Tyrant. The corresponding Final Flight is automatic20. Apex Assault is an active technique despite its source passive heading.
workedExample: Dragoon5, STR16, PB3, S2, M3; start Momentum0. Know Dragon Leap, Momentum Surge, Wyvern's Guard and Draconic Roar at1; Momentum Engine and Draconic Discipline at2; Dragonflight and Momentum Overflow at3. Capacity7.
Turn1: Dragon Leap spends0 Momentum and moves20ft of Speed30. Weapon attack hits: movement+hit each gain1, ending2. It rolls weapon damage+2d6. Land immediately.
Turn2: Bonus Action Momentum Surge spends2, balance0, increases movement. Move20ft and use ordinary Attack Action: first successful hit and movement return2 total, even if both attacks hit. End2.
Turn3: Dragonflight costs2, balance0. It supplies movement up to60ft as part of the Action; hit and movement regain2 within the common cap. End2; no additional normal Attack Action.
Turn4: if knocked prone, use Aerial Recovery only if known and your Reaction is available. Its1 Momentum still counts toward the round gain cap. A second refund cannot exceed2 total gains.
End encounter: Momentum0. RP, per-rest uses and other party resources do not refill.
